pressure_node.description: Floor 1 Pressure Tap Node with ESP-NOW auto-discovery, sub-10ms Node 2 telemetry receiver, and Core 1 decoupled drain.

ultrasonic_node.description: Ultrasonic Tank Node with ESP-NOW fast broadcast, emergency overflow pump cutoff, and 10-sample batching.

pump_node.description: Pump Relay Node with active built-in LED signaling (2Hz on relay active), dynamic peer discovery, maintainWiFi loop, and web UI.
